# Undetectable AI

> Free AI detection and humanization platform for identifying ChatGPT, GPT-5, Gemini, Claude content and AI-generated images while bypassing detection systems.

Undetectable AI provides comprehensive tools for detecting AI-generated text and images from major models like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Midjourney, as well as humanization capabilities to rephrase AI content. The platform serves users needing content verification, plagiarism detection, and image authenticity checking.

## Core Detection Tools

- [AI Detector for ChatGPT, GPT-5, Gemini (Free)](https://undetectable.ai): Main AI detector tool for ChatGPT, GPT-5, Gemini and Claude content verification
- [AI Image Detector: Check AI Photos & Images Free](https://undetectable.ai/ai-image-detector): AI image detector identifying photos from Midjourney, DALL-E, and other generators
- [AI Detector, AI Checker, & AI Humanizer](https://undetectable.ai/detector-humanizer): Combined AI detection and humanization tool to bypass detection systems
